summary: The Signal silence alert no longer fires on a quiet room: signal-cli's keep-alive now counts as the connection being alive.
details: PlatformSilent fired about 108 times in 14 days for Signal alone and resolved itself each time a message arrived; the listener ignored signal-cli's keep-alive line, so only a message reset the clock.
An adapter age over 900 seconds now means the socket is silent, on every platform.
limitations: A stuck-but-connected signal-cli that keeps sending keep-alives and delivers no messages is not detected by this alert.
